title: Mithras liturgy ascent through seven heavens

tellings.quote: In the Mithras liturgy found in Greek magical Papyri, an initiate employs breathing techniques, visualizations, chants, and ceremonial rituals to ascend through the seven heavens.

plain: In the Mithras Liturgy, an ancient religious text found among the Greek Magical Papyri, a collection of spells and rites written on papyrus in the Greek and Roman world, a person being initiated uses breathing techniques, visualisations, chants and ceremonies to rise up through seven heavens. Michels tells this himself, citing the texts, as an ancient example of a practice for leaving ordinary reality.
